title: The Open Water Dissolution

features.name: the horizon's agreement
features.desc-on-touch: You see where the two towns' water finally learned they were one river. There is no line between them anymore.

features.name: the resting current
features.desc-on-touch: The water has stopped choosing which way to go. It listens instead of flows.

features.name: doubled artifact
features.desc-on-touch: A thing that came from town A, that also came from town B. The archive cannot decide which shore made it.

features.name: the archive stops broadcasting
features.desc-on-touch: At the edge of the open water, the signal finally learns to be silent. It is the most beautiful transmission it has ever sent.

inscription: where all roads to the ocean finally agree there is no road anymore

file.note: The moment when the archive stopped distinguishing between upstream and downstream, and learned that convergence is not confusion but consent

reverie.title: REVERIE — the confluence at golden hour
narr: The water around your ankles was neither town's water anymore.
She stood upriver, you downriver, both of you in the same current.
For once, the archive did not need to remember which version was true.
The sun made a single path. You walked it together toward the open sea.
Neither of you asked which direction the current was taking you.

exits.label: back up the river toward the two towns that are still learning to be one
outward along the horizon where the map itself dissolves into open water
following the shore where the land still remembers it was not ocean
